newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Airlines to offer special fares.
newsitem.headline: Southwest Airlines to offer special fares.

text.p: Southwest Airlines said Wednesday it is offering special fares that are at least 50 percent lower than the usual full fares, with none higher than $99 one-way nationwide.

For example, the one-way sale fare from Chicago to Cleveland is $39 one-way, a 50.6 percent savings over the usual $79 one-way full fare. From Houston to Las Vegas, the one-way sale fare is $99, a 61.6 percent savings over the usual $258 one-way full fare.
The company said fares must be purchased within one day of making reservations and by Saturday, Aug. 9.
Travel for these special fares is valid beginning Sept. 3 through Dec. 16 with these blackout dates: Nov. 25 through Dec. 1.
Fares are quoted one-way with no stayover required. Seats are limited and may not be available during peak travel times.
Southwest Airlines currently serves 50 cities in 24 states.
